expected_level_description: You can: - run a range of administrative processes for a team with little supervision - spot and fix errors in records and data - suggest simpler ways of working

You can: - produce well-formatted documents and presentations quickly and accurately - use spreadsheets to sort, filter, and summarise data - use collaboration tools to manage shared documents and versions
You can: - handle routine correspondence and enquiries yourself - draft letters and replies for others to sign - keep correspondence logs and chase replies
You can: - manage diaries for a team, resolving clashes - arrange travel, events, and meetings with outside partners - make sure papers and actions are ready before meetings
You can: - write accurate, concise minutes and action logs for routine meetings - follow up actions with their owners
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
